summary: Frontend E2E testing of the Puff2Door loyalty/rewards feature via the public preview URL. Covered: new customer registration -> My Rewards empty state (0 pts), checkout rewards panel (balance / earn preview / not-redeemable), paid order earning (120 pts via API test_card since PayPal hides Test Card UI), order page rewards block, redemption at checkout (100 pts -> -$5.00, tax recalculated on subtotal-5, total reduced), redeemed order page + ledger, guest checkout rewards prompt (no redeem select) + guest order + far-ZIP delivery block, PUFF10 promo in cart, empty-cart redirect, admin Loyalty Rewards settings (read/save/persist/restore, Store Settings save does not reset loyalty), admin customer lookup + manual adjustment (required reason, +50, over-balance error toast), admin refund ($10 -> 10 pts reversed) and Cancelled status (35 reversed + 100 returned), Zelle order placed fully through the UI (lands on /order/:id, pending-points message) then admin Mark Paid -> +120 pts, and regression smoke (/, /shop, /sitemap.xml 200, 67 products, header category/brand dropdowns populated, GET /api/settings has loyalty block, GET /api/loyalty/me = 401 unauthenticated). Ledger math verified end-to-end: 120 -> redeem/earn -> 55 -> +50 adjust -> 105 -> -10 refund -> -35 cancel -> +100 return -> 160 -> +120 Zelle = 280 pts / $14.00. No blocking defects found.

minor.issue: Tax rounding differs from the UI: backend uses Python round() (banker's) so 35.00 x 6.5% -> 2.27 while checkout UI shows 2.28 (toFixed). Result: order total charged $52.27 vs $52.28 previewed at checkout (1c mismatch whenever the cents land on a .xx5 boundary).

Create-order response returns pointsRedeemed: null; the persisted order uses rewardPoints (100). Response field is inconsistent/unused - consider returning pointsRedeemed = rewardPoints for API consumers.

ui_bugs.issue: For a cancelled order the Delivery Tracker still renders with 'In Progress' label and an active 'Order Placed' step below the red 'Order cancelled' banner - contradictory state.

After successful registration the app redirects to '/' instead of remaining on /my-account, so the new customer does not immediately see the My Rewards section (works after navigating back to /my-account).
React console warning 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' on /checkout (dynamic expression inside <option>). Console noise only; select works.

PayPal smart buttons occasionally stay at 'Loading PayPal...' for >15s (one run had 0 iframes after 15s; a later run rendered 2 iframes). Since Test Card UI is hidden, the only card path can appear unavailable for a while. Consider a timeout fallback message / allowing another method.

issues: Product thumbnails intermittently render blank when navigating quickly (image requests aborted); the /api/files/... URLs return 200 on direct fetch, so this is a load/abort timing nit, not a broken asset.

action_items: Align checkout tax/total rounding with the backend (backend round() gives 2.27 while UI shows 2.28) so the previewed total always equals the charged total.
Hide/neutralize the Delivery Tracker on cancelled orders.
Keep the user on /my-account after registration so My Rewards is visible immediately (or redirect to /my-account).
Add a load-timeout fallback for the PayPal buttons (or expose an alternate method) when the SDK is slow.
Optional: return pointsRedeemed (= rewardPoints) in the create-order response for consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: RewardsPanel.jsx clamps redeemPoints in a useEffect on maxRedeem only; server-side validation (loyalty_validate_redeem) correctly re-checks, which was verified (guest redeem attempt -> 401 'Sign in to your Puff2door account to redeem rewards').

price_cart/create_order compute reward discount server-side and the ledger uses idempotent keys (redeem:<orderId>, redeem-return:<orderId>) - reversal on cancel after a partial refund correctly reversed only the remaining 35 pts.

success_rate.backend: 100% (2 spot checks: /api/settings loyalty block present, /api/loyalty/me 401 unauth)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of loyalty flows functional; 4 low/medium cosmetic issues

context_for_next_testing_agent: Test Card UI is hidden while PayPal is enabled (testCard.visible=false in /api/payments/config); to place a PAID order use POST /api/orders with paymentMethod test_card + Bearer token, or place a Zelle order through the UI and Mark Paid in /admin/orders (this earns points and is the only full UI checkout path). Age gate must be dismissed via [data-testid=age-gate-yes]. Product detail route is /shop/:slug (not /product/:slug); add-to-cart testid is detail-add-to-cart. Admin refund uses two window.prompt dialogs (amount, then reason); Cancelled status uses window.confirm.
rca_of_the_issue: Tax mismatch RCA: server.py price_cart uses Python round((subtotal-discount)*taxRate, 2); for 35.00*0.065 = 2.2750 float repr rounds down to 2.27, while the React summary uses toFixed(2) -> 2.28. Fix by using a shared half-up rounding helper (e.g. Decimal ROUND_HALF_UP server-side) so displayed and charged totals match.
